rationale: Round 4 shows complete hardening on the core trade-offs: employee/state actors still reject closures and forced redundancies, while owners, investors, and management still insist they must remain available if the numbers require it. The parties have converged only on process and an audit, not on the substantive conflict, so further rounds are likely to repeat the same positions unless a stronger intervening mechanism forces a quantified joint model or narrowing of the issue.
